issues.jp_before: 今夜[こんや]{は|wa-topic}温[あたた]かいスープ{が/を|tai-ga-o}飲[の]みたいです。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the cold water / cold juice / cold drink items, and the verb 飲む is used more than three times in the batch.
issues.action: Replaced with a ピザを頼みたい item (same skill, same slot structure).

issues.jp_before: 駅前[えきまえ]{で|de-place}傘[かさ]{を/が|tai-ga-o}買[か]いたいです。
issues.problem: The verb 買う is used four times in the file (lines 3, 23, 34, 47).
issues.action: Replaced with タクシーを拾いたい.

issues.jp_before: 最近[さいきん]{は|wa-topic}ドラマ{を/が|tai-ga-o}ゆっくり見[み]たいです。
issues.problem: Semantically awkward ('want to watch dramas slowly lately'), and 見る is used four times.
issues.action: Replaced with もっと漢字を覚えたいです。

issues.jp_before: 小[ちい]さい頃[ころ]{は|wa-topic}サッカー{が/を|tai-ga-o}したかったです。
issues.problem: Distractor に gives サッカーにしたかった ('wanted to go with soccer'), which is grammatical and close to the English.
issues.action: Distractors changed to の / へ / と.

issues.jp_before: 海外[かいがい]{で|de-place}いろいろな経験[けいけん]{を/が|tai-ga-o}したいです。
issues.problem: Distractor に gives 経験にしたい, which is grammatical (with a different meaning but plausible), so it is not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Distractors changed to の / へ / と.

issues.jp_before: 寝[ね]る前[まえ]{に|maeni-atode}日記[にっき]{を/が|tai-ga-o}書[か]きたいです。
issues.problem: Distractor に gives 日記に書きたい, which is natural and matches the English 'write in my diary'. へ is also marginal.
issues.action: English changed to 'write my diary'; distractors changed to の / と / で.

issues.jp_before: 彼女[かのじょ]{に|te-hoshii}いつも笑[わら]っていてほしいです。
issues.problem: Distractor が: with a state predicate (笑っていてほしい) 彼女が is natural.
issues.action: Added が as an alternative ({に/が}); distractors changed to を / と / で; why updated.

issues.jp_before: 娘[むすめ]{に|te-hoshii}幸[しあわ]せ{に|ni-change}なってほしいです。
issues.problem: Distractor が: 娘が幸せになってほしい is very common and natural with a non-volitional change.
issues.action: Added が as an alternative ({に/が}); distractors changed to を / と / で; why updated.

issues.jp_before: 友達[ともだち]{に|te-hoshii}この本[ほん]{を|o-object}読[よ]んでほしいです。
issues.problem: lv 5 is too low because ～てほしい is N4 grammar.

issues.jp_before: 母[はは]{に|te-hoshii}日曜日[にちようび]{に|ni-time}カレー{を|o-object}作[つく]ってほしいです。
issues.problem: lv 5 is too low because ～てほしい is N4 grammar.

issues.jp_before: 学生[がくせい]{に|te-hoshii}もっと本[ほん]{を|o-object}読[よ]んでほしい{と|to-quote}先生[せんせい]{は|wa-topic}言[い]いました。
issues.problem: The English assumed the teacher's gender ('he').
issues.action: English changed to 'The teacher said they want ...'.
